summary: Iteration 29 retest of find-near + new UI animations. Backend: strict probe 'where can I park close to my delivery in Stockton' + 'and a hotel there' passed 10/10 for both steps (truck_stop near Stockton, 'from your delivery' + 'miles from you'; hotel Econo Lodge Stockton). One run of the follow-up was classified intent=pick and the fallback still worked. 6 phrasing variants (Lodi, Modesto 'drop', 'park near Stockton', 'rest area near Stockton' -> truck_stop fallback, address -> 'right at 2828 El Centro Rd') all route_set. pytest iter27 + iter28 find_near + iter28 review_flows: 28/28 passed. Two new issues: (1) after a find-near dialog, a plain 'I need fuel' in the same session searches near the old point (Stockton, 55 mi) instead of around the driver, 2/2 runs, caused by the new category-change reuse rule; (2) the Where to? prefix rule sends single category words as 'Take me to X', so typing 'hotel' routes to 'The Hotel Bar' (a destination). Frontend (390x844): 'Reno' -> 'You said: "Take me to Reno"'; 'I need fuel' -> 'You said: "I need fuel"' (sent as typed, Roady's Truck Stop). The TopBar, route summary/place name, parking label ('Likely fits a truck') and NavBanner all render at opacity 1. The NavBanner instruction changed 3 times while walking the geolocation along the route and stayed visible each time. Avatar ripple ring 1 animates while thinking and speaking; ring 2 only while speaking (listening not testable without a mic). No console errors or warnings.

minor.issue: Sticky near point: after 'find a hotel near Stockton', 'I need fuel' in the same session routes to Flying J 6.8 mi from Stockton / 55 mi from the driver instead of a stop near the driver (Roady's 4.6 mi). Cause: _near_followup reuses sess['near'] whenever last.category != category (agent.py:415-417). Reproduced 2/2 (tests/probe_iter29_near_leak.py).
'find me a rest area near Stockton' silently falls back to a truck stop. The reply doesn't say no rest area was found ('Flying J Travel Center, 6.8 miles from Stockton...'). agent.py:435-439

ui_bugs.issue: The regex at index.tsx:892 only lets requests with verbs or pronouns through, so bare category words get the 'Take me to' prefix. 'hotel' -> 'Take me to hotel' -> route to 'The Hotel Bar' (category destination, 1.1 mi). 'truck stop' -> destination 'West Sac Truck Stop' (geocoded, no options list). 'diesel' and 'rest area' happen to work.

action_items: agent.py _near_followup: don't reuse sess['near'] just because the category changed. Reuse it only for explicit references (there / near it / same area / 'and a X' / 'also') or when the model returns near. Alternatively clear sess['near'] after a search around the driver. Otherwise 'I need fuel' mid-dialog sends the driver 55 mi away.

index.tsx:892: add category words to the 'send as typed' regex (hotel|motel|fuel|diesel|def|truck ?stop|rest ?area|parking|food|shower|sleep), or send all typed text as-is and let the LLM classify it.
Optional: when the rest_area -> truck_stop fallback in _find_near fires, say so ('No rest area near Stockton, closest truck stop is ...').
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py:552-562: intent=parking with near=null and no place still returns 'Which place?'. Not seen in 16 live runs, but the fallback depends on the model filling near.
agent.py:552-561 duplicates the RouteFailed/PlacesUnavailable except blocks from 543-548. Move the parking-near branch inside the main try.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested flows (28/28 pytest, 10/10 + 10/10 probe); 2 new minor issues
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (caption flows and animations OK; category-word prefix bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest from /app/backend. Probes are standalone: python tests/probe_iter29_find_near.py 10; python tests/probe_iter29_near_variants.py "phrase" ... (argv phrases or the defaults); python tests/probe_iter29_near_leak.py. For web: grant geolocation 38.58,-121.49, enter TRUCK2026 in access-code-input, then onboarding-skip-button. To test NavBanner instruction changes, capture route.geometry from the /api/agent response and call set_geolocation along it after go-button.
rca_of_issue: Sticky near: _near_followup returns sess['near']['query'] when last.category != category, even without 'there'. Any new-category request after a find-near search inherits the old point. Repro: session X, 'find a hotel near Stockton', then 'I need fuel' with active_place = the hotel -> Flying J near Stockton.
